titre: After Playing Infinity Nikki 3.0 for Four Hours, its New Cities and Outfits Are Just Some of the Additions Worth Returning For
chapo: The new 3.0 update has tons of new stuff to explore including new locations, outfits and gameplay systems, although don't expect any kind of proper challenge.
extrait: When Infinity Nikki first launched in 2024, it introduced players around the world to the dress-up world of mobile game star Nikki in her first 3D console/PC adventure, an open world filled with wholesome fun, fashion and friendship. 2025’s V2.0 update introduced a new area to the world of Miraland, as well as new ways to traverse it. But now with the new V3.0 update titled Of Yesterday and Tomorrow, Nikki’s wonderful world has been expanded significantly – with its richest locations yet, and even a cute convertible to traverse it with. To give you an idea of how huge this update is, I played for over four hours at developer Infold’s Shanghai office, focusing mainly on story content and with only the slightest bit of open-world exploration and lifestyle simulation gameplay, and didn't even see all of one of its two new cities. The golden path apparently offers some nine hours of story content, with two dense and exciting new areas to get lost in. Between the V3.0 launch and Nikki’s birthday celebration campaign, players can get 160 free draws and 19 new sets of clothing. I spent most of my time in Cicia, a city of art, based loosely on Paris among other places, and lined with cobblestone streets and beatific brickwork architecture. Cicia was previously featured as a location in the mobile game Shining Nikki, and makes its 3D debut here. It’s a world where art nouveau, belle epoque and art deco collide, and home to the Cicia Art Academy where Miraland’s most promising students are taught lessons of art creation and appraisal by the finest tutors. When Nikki receives an invitation to study there, she and her catlike companion Momo embark on a new adventure of aesthetic discovery. But is everything at the academy truly as it seems? Some of the outfits in the update grant Nikki new skills. Unlock and craft the preppy four-star Leaping Breeze outfit to gain a higher double-jump and airborne dash abilities, while the much darker and sexier Night’s Hidden Side outfit allows Nikki to “bind” with objects around the environment (think Mario’s possession skill in Mario Odyssey) and use them to warp to hard-to-reach places. These new skills allow for a new level of verticality in Cicia’s map and dungeons, helping you explore the castle spires or negotiate intricate dungeon maps. extrait: Explore two new cities, discover new abilities and combat systems, and more. Explore two new cities, experience nearly 10 hours of cinematic storytelling, discover new abilities and combat systems, and celebrate Nikki’s Birthday to enjoy 160 draws in total, plus 19 sets of clothes—all free. Today we announced Infinity Nikki Version 3.0, a major update that takes Nikki and Momo’s adventure to the Twin Cities of Art: Cicia and Ceremius, which releases on PS5 later today. Featuring nearly 10 hours of immersive story with cinematic presentation, the update introduces new exploration abilities, expanded combat systems, diverse open-world activities, and a more lifelike city experience. Alongside the new content, Version 3.0 and Nikki’s Birthday bring 160 draws and 19 sets of clothes, as well as improvements that make the adventure more accessible to new and returning stylists. In Version 3.0, Nikki and Momo’s adventure unfolds across Cicia and Ceremius, two cities that share a common origin but could hardly be more different. Beyond everyday academy life in Cicia, the capital of art, Nikki gets caught up in strange anomalies on the streets and an investigation into the Rogues. Crossing the mist into Ceremius, she explores where the city’s past meets its present crisis, drawing ever closer to the truth about the Goddess des Arts. Across the two cities, stylists will have access to four key abilities: Veiling, Alchemy, Enhanced Floating, and Gemwork, adding more possibilities for exploration and puzzle-solving. With the Veiling Ability, stylists can throw the Shadow Beetle and choose when to teleport. When it hits certain objects, they can switch to the object’s view and control it. Combined with the city’s anomalies and mechanisms in dungeons, movement becomes part of how stylists observe their surroundings, find their way, and solve puzzles. Through Alchemy, stylists can gather materials in the open world and brew potions with Basic Recipes, or develop new recipes through trial-crafting. Potions can be used in combat, environmental puzzles, scene creation, and NPC interactions, connecting gathering, crafting, and exploration. The Enhanced Floating ability allows Nikki to jump again in midair for a nimble double jump and dash forward through the air, while the Gemwork ability lets her discover and appraise uncut gemstones across the open world, then work them into gems for outfit crafting and Alchemy.
